title: Build Infinigen native libs and brighten kitchen ceiling lights
objective: Build the missing native Infinigen terrain/OcMesher libraries needed by real_geometry.gin, then update the imported infinigen_indoors_kitchen Unreal map to use bright ceiling lights that remain reducible/disableable via the existing --scene-light-intensity-scale runtime parameter, and recook/package/verify the map.
instructions: Create a run directory under .control-tower/runs named for this task and launch all long-running work in a named tmux session/window. Return the tmux attach command, exact commands run, log paths, status files, and verification outputs.

First build native Infinigen libs from /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen using: cd /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen && source /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate infinigen && make terrain. Tee full output to the run log. Verify these files exist and load with ctypes: /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/terrain/lib/cpu/sdf_from_mesh/sdf_from_mesh.so and /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/infinigen/OcMesher/ocmesher/lib/core.so. If make terrain fails after partially building, preserve logs and try the Scout-recommended direct fallback only for those two critical libs, then report whether full terrain build or minimal real_geometry unblock succeeded.

Then update /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/infinigen_indoors_kitchen/Maps/infinigen_indoors_kitchen with bright, overhead, movable ceiling RectLight fixtures. Use an editor script stored in the run directory, not product source. Destroy/replace the previous InfinigenKitchen_* fixtures. Use realistic warm-white commercial ceiling lighting at base scale 1.0, with multiple rectangular area fixtures across the kitchen ceiling, and keep setup skylight/directional low enough not to wash out flashlight testing. The existing runtime --scene-light-intensity-scale must be able to reduce these scene lights; do not change product code unless a blocker is discovered.

After lighting edits, validate and record map_exists, mesh asset/static mesh actor counts, light actor/component counts, labels, intensities, mobility, bounds, and the intended launch command. Recook/package the active Linux build including all non-null docs/environment_ledger.json map paths, verify both archive and staged paks contain infinigen_indoors_kitchen .umap and .uexp, and dry-run tools/spear-run live infinigen_indoors_kitchen --setting realistic-2x.

Include exact user-facing commands in the result: the native lib build command, the direct live command for bright ceiling lights at scale 1.0, a reduced/dim command, and a scene-off command using --scene-light-intensity-scale 0.0 or --disable-scene-lights.
constraints: Do not edit tracked product code unless you hit a clear blocker; report to Tower instead.
expected_outputs: Native library build status is verified; kitchen map has bright base ceiling lights; Linux package is recooked and pak-verified; spear-run dry-run resolves; result includes exact commands.
definition_of_done: ctypes load verification succeeds for required native libs or a concrete compiler/dependency blocker is reported; paks verify the kitchen map after lighting changes; exact commands are included.
